name: validate_json
description: Validate candidate output text against a JSON Schema. Returns {valid, feedback}; when invalid, feed the feedback back to the model and retry. The output may be any JSON value; otherwise the first fenced block, or the first object or array in the text, is used. $schema selects draft-04, draft-06, draft-07, 2019-09 or 2020-12 (default); $ref resolves only inside the one schema ("#", "#/...", "#name"), so a remote reference or an embedded $id is refused. pattern is Python re syntax, without inline flags, look-behind, backreferences, atomic or possessive groups, conditional groups or \N{...}; a document's patterns get 500 ms in total.
